claims.claim_text: I observed a male subject peering over the brick perimeter wall of the enclosed rear patio area.
I stood in the walkway approximately 40 feet east and used my flashlight.
The subject stated he was there to see the reporting party.
He refused to show his hands and told me to stop shining the flashlight.
The subject exited the patio area wearing a baggy black jacket, blue jeans, a black hat, and clear glasses with a beverage can in his right hand.
He moved the beverage can from his right hand to his left hand.
He placed his right hand into his right front jacket pocket.
Corporal Estrada deployed his Taser, striking the subject in the back. The subject fell onto his left side and then flat on his back.
The subject reached toward his right-side waistband and drew what appeared to be a black Glock handgun.
I fired my duty weapon 21 rounds. Corporal Estrada fired nine rounds.
The weapon was a Glock 22, .40-caliber, registered to the subject's father.
He pointed the weapon in the direction of Corporal Estrada.
